questions.explanation: KR$NA's "MAHARANI" (2020) has "Raftaar bhaiya mujhe saans nahi aa rahi thi". "Kehke" (by saying) marks Encore's words as a quote.

options.text: πr²: you're out of my space

questions.explanation: "Tu pai yaar" sounds like "two pi r", and 2πr is a circle's circumference: outside it means out of the inner circle. It also sounds close to "bhai yaar" (brother, friend).

questions.prompt: *Don't Try This At Home* has one artist besides KR$NA and Seedhe Maut. Who?
questions.explanation: Raftaar is credited as a third main artist on "Fillet Mignion". He is the EP's only guest.

questions.prompt: Which song opens *Don't Try This At Home*?
questions.explanation: "BUZZ" is track 1. It was already out as a single before the EP dropped on 20 Nov 2026.

questions.prompt: Which film's famous dialogue does "na jhukega" flip?
questions.explanation: Allu Arjun plays Pushpa Raj, whose line is "Jhukega nahi saala". Raftaar adds an "M": "Mallu" is slang for a Malayali, and he was born in Trivandrum, Kerala.

bar: Na hi khaata hoon main beef, na hi suar
Na hi karta hoon main suaron se beef

options.text: A rap feud, and a fake friend

questions.explanation: Encore ABJ ends both bars on "beef": first the meat, then the feud. "Suar" (pork) becomes "suaron" (pigs), his word for rivals. He won't feud with pigs.

questions.prompt: Which track on *Don't Try This At Home* is a one-minute skit?
questions.explanation: "Late / Latte (Skit)" runs 1:02, the shortest track on the EP. The title sets two near sound-alike words side by side.

questions.prompt: Which song closes the EP and is also its longest, at 4:56?
questions.explanation: "Fillet Mignion" is track 6 (4:56). "Mujhe Nahi Chahiye" comes next at 4:41. Stores spell the title "Fillet Mignion", not "Filet Mignon".

questions.prompt: Before this EP, Seedhe Maut featured on which song from KR$NA's 2025 mixtape *Yours Truly*?
questions.explanation: "Sensitive" (feat. Seedhe Maut) is on *Yours Truly* (22 May 2025). "Hola Amigo" and "Khatta Flow" were their 2023 songs together.

questions.lead: Complete the bar from "Mujhe Nahi Chahiye"
bar: Mujhe nahi chahiye log aise jo Jai Veeru bolein par bhool jaate ___
questions.explanation: Jai and Veeru are the best friends of *Sholay* (1975). Calm doesn't want people who call themselves Jai-Veeru but forget what that friendship meant.

bar: ye saare hain machhar, hum ja rahe all out
questions.prompt: What two meanings does "all out" carry?

options.text: Full effort, and a mosquito repellent
Full effort, and a power cut
Running away, and a mosquito net
Lights out, and a mosquito coil

questions.explanation: Encore ABJ calls rivals "machhar" (mosquitoes). "All out" means full effort, and All Out is a mosquito repellent sold in India. One phrase, two meanings, two languages.

questions.explanation: "Mujhe Nahi Chahiye" (4:41) comes straight after the opener, "BUZZ". The skit is track 3.

questions.prompt: In 2026, KR$NA and Raftaar judged a new hip-hop reality show. What is it called?
questions.explanation: *Legacy* (2026), presented by Kalamkaar Music and SVF Music, has KR$NA and Raftaar as judges. It aired on YouTube, then ZEE5.

bar: Badlega waqt ye bol nahi paate, In baato me wazan ye ___ nahi paate
questions.explanation: "Wazan" (weight) calls for "tol" (to weigh). "Nahi paate" repeats at every line end (radeef) while the rhyme word before it changes: rok, bol, tol (qaafiya).

Milein mujhe toh humble hain, trouble hai, beta, mat khoj
questions.explanation: It's KR$NA's verse. The Chambal ravines were once known for dacoits. Jungle, Chambal, humble and trouble rhyme across Hindi and English.

bar: Tu banna chahta star hai, lekin taare tere not align
questions.explanation: It's Encore ABJ's verse. "Star" (famous) in English and "taare" (stars, fate) in Hindi: you want to be a star, but your stars won't align.

bar: Agar JFK sa AFK tu aaj kahan se bhaag raha hai?

options.text: John F. Kennedy, a US President

questions.explanation: JFK is John F. Kennedy, the US President shot dead in 1963. Encore's whole verse runs on "dead presidents", and "JFK sa AFK" means as still as JFK: dead.
